description: Invite an external guest to a Workspace by email, with optional capability flags. Returns the created guest. Enterprise plan only. Use to bring in a client/contractor before sharing specific tasks, Lists or Folders with them.

can_create_views.description: Allow the guest to create Views on shared items.

can_edit_tags.description: Allow the guest to add/remove tags on shared items.

can_see_time_estimated.description: Allow the guest to see time estimates on shared items.

can_see_time_spent.description: Allow the guest to see time tracked on shared items.

email.description: Email address of the guest to invite.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: invite_guest
